set.statement: When a run driver sees its session stop at a usage limit, it records the hit's time and reset time in the git common dir's rhiza state, which the daemon reads at each poll. The hit's window kind comes from its reset time: a reset 5 hours or less after the hit is the session window, a later one the weekly window, and a hit with no reset time teaches nothing. The daemon saves that window's use at the hit as the learned limit for its kind and uses it only when that kind has no live limit (usage-live-limit) and its rhiza.daemon.usage.<kind> setting is unset; a window with none of the three never holds
